reason: The mode whose Method gains the rule: it writes code and scripts and runs the project verdict, so the two halves - run the tool, write the reusable script - are its own work.
The mode that confirms defects by meeting preconditions, where the rule says an obligation is met by running something and the script that ran belongs in the record.
The mode whose value is invoking tools against an authorized target; the rule lands in During the run, next to the scope rules it must not be read as overriding.
What a mode file may state and how its sections are read, which is the constraint the new rules are written against.
